Product Features

  • SPACIOUS AND STYLISH: The 160m TV stand can accommodate a 70-inch TV, perfect for an impressive entertainment center.
  • HIGH-QUALITY MATERIALS: Made of durable MDF for durability.
  • Elegant gray pattern: The special texture will add a touch of elegance to your space.
  • Marble-look tabletop: The tabletop is finished with a marble-look décor that brings a luxurious feel to your living room.
  • Efficient cable management: 2 holes on the back for a clean look and no annoying cables.
  • Organized storage: 4 drawers with push-to-open function provide ample storage space.
  • Stylish Glass Panels: 2 vertically striped glass doors and storage space at the back add a touch of elegance.
  • Note: This product consists of 2 packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!
  • Note: When using the 4 drawers, it is recommended to press on the center of the drawer, not the sides.

Descriptions

Immerse yourself in the ultimate home cinema experience with the exquisite 160m TV cabinet. This piece of furniture can accommodate a 70-inch TV and is made of high-quality MDF that combines durability and elegance. The unique grey pattern gives the TV cabinet a distinctive aesthetic, while the marble-look tabletop on the top adds a touch of luxury. With the 2 handy cable management holes on the back, you'll keep your entertainment area neat and organized. (The tabletop is not a marble top, but a marble-veined decal)
